title: Quantum-classical hybrid models based on error correction for time series forecasting
authors: Paulo S. G. de Mattos Neto
summary: Time series forecasting largely benefits from combining the strengths of different models, especially using a scheme where a model corrects another model by capturing supplementary patterns from forecasting errors. Concurrently, quantum models are providing a means to augment the classical capacity, including in time series forecasting, by acting alongside classical models in hybrid architectures.
